# spx_vm_types (Data Source)

Retrieves the list of Instance types available for a project and an AZ.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Instance types available for the vm_type argument of spx_instance
data "spx_vm_types" "all" {}

output "vm_types" {
  value = data.spx_vm_types.all.types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (List of String) The list of available Instance types.
